items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 1:31PM PST until November 26 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Tidal overflow flooding.

* WHERE...Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding, up to one foot above ground level,
during high tides is expected in the low lying areas near bays,
sloughs, and the lower reaches of the coastal rivers.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding is
expected. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled.
items.description: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 26 at 12:39PM PST until November 28 at 1:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and
hazardous seas 12 to 17 ft at 14 seconds and southwest winds
10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt. For the Small Craft
Advisory, seas 9 to 14 ft at 17 seconds and north winds 10 to
20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Hazardous Seas Warning, until 1 AM PST Friday. Small
Craft Advisory, from 1 AM Friday to 1 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or cause
damage to vessels.
items.instruction:
A Hazardous Seas Warning means hazardous sea conditions are
imminent or occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in
port, or take shelter until waves subside.  Commercial vessels
should prepare for rough seas and consider remaining in port or
taking shelter in port until hazardous seas subside.
